integrity: All claims depend on the included all-n analytical proof; the standalone exact rational checks are supporting diagnostics, not an independent proof.
scientific_limitations: Real trace-free symmetric coefficient matrices and even ambient dimensions at least six; only rank-k real orthogonal projectors and fourth moment. Rank-one and isolated Gr(2,4) cases not claimed novel. Bibliographic priority remains unverified independently.
title: A sharp fourth-moment spectral phase transition on real Grassmannians
